summary.name: pitchboom
summary.one_liner: pitchboom is an AI motion-design studio that turns a product URL or short brief into a video ad with script, storyboard, voice-over and music.
use_cases: turn a product page into a short video ad
create social ads for TikTok, Reels or Shorts
generate multiple ad hook variants to test
localize a video ad into other languages
make ad creatives in several aspect ratios
produce a quick explainer-style promo from a brief
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a product URL or a short brief, plus a chosen goal, platform preset, length and tone. It writes the script, builds an editable scene-by-scene storyboard, and adds a voice-over and music. It renders on-brand MP4 videos at 1080p (4K on higher plans) in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4. Users can edit scenes and text, lock a Brand Kit, produce several takes from one brief, and translate finished videos into many languages. Pricing is per second of finished video in credits.
notable: Turns a product URL or two-line brief into a storyboarded, voice-overed video ad
Re-lays out each scene for 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4 rather than cropping
Estimate shown before each paid step; edits to storyboard are free
Translation into 34 languages with new voice-over and captions
caveats: Creating videos after the 875 one-time free credits requires a paid subscription, starting at €30/month excl. VAT
Free accounts are limited to Standard videos up to 30 seconds in 1080p, one at a time
Default setting publicly lists finished videos in a gallery unless made private; 4K needs Pro or higher or a per-second surcharge
